issue: Operating FLNG (Hilli Episeyo) is on track to CEASE operations in Cameroon when the Perenco/SNH charter ends in 2026. Golar signed a 20-year charter (2025) to redeploy the vessel offshore Argentina (Southern Energy / RGLNG, Gulf of San Matias); vessel to enter Seatrium's Singapore yard ~Q3 2026 for upgrade, then sail to Argentina (start ~2027). Unless a replacement FLNG is chartered for Cameroon (none currently announced), Cameroon FLNG export ceases in 2026. GEM row is still 'operating' with no stop/relocation timeline. Discovery found NO replacement-vessel project for Cameroon (so this is a status change on the existing row, not a new terminal).
